# Pitch in Public

> Guided pitch preparation for founder programs and startup events, connecting an event Pitch Standard to a founder Pitch Plan, private practice, structured human feedback, and a Best Take.

Pitch in Public serves two connected audiences:

- Organizers coordinate pitch standards, configurable one-to-six-minute durations, founder and reviewer invitations, controlled cohort practice, final submissions, private pitch decks, announcements, and activity-based outcome reporting.
- Founders turn the event standard into a focused Pitch Plan, record event takes, receive criterion-bound feedback from people, revise, and choose a Best Take.

Important product facts:

- Pitch in Public is currently invite-only.
- Feedback is written by people; the product does not use AI to coach or score founders.
- Event pitches are private to the event by default. Founders control whether an eligible take moves to the public feed.
- Reports summarize activity and do not claim that Pitch in Public caused an outcome.
- Daily solo practice is available as a separate practice mode.
